headline.lastSession: From your last therapy session to an active life
headline.therapyEnded: Therapy ended. Your movement goes on.
headline.stillYours: Training is still yours, whatever your body has been through

hero.body: Azm measures how you move today, builds an exercise plan that fits your medical condition, coaches every session through your phone camera, then measures again so you can see for yourself how your movement changes.

example.test: Arm raise to the side, right

loop.title: How Azm works
loop.intro: Four steps that start from your own movement and come back to it with every new check.

measure.title: Measure
measure.body: Azm measures your movement for your own tracking, with a short check through your phone camera that sets your own starting point.

prescribe.title: Plan
prescribe.body: Clear medical rules, not AI, choose the movements and the amount that fit your medical condition. You can start from a photo of your medical report.

coach.title: Coach
coach.body: In every session the camera counts your reps and corrects you to your own range, with a calm Arabic voice beside you. The video never leaves your device.

prove.title: Measure again
prove.body: Every four weeks we measure again so you can see the change, compared only with yourself.

close.title: Your body changed. Your resolve did not.
close.body: Start free, for yourself or for someone in your family. Every session is saved so you can follow your training yourself.
